description: This file defines the ProductType entity class used in the sales management system, including mappings to database columns, primary key configuration, and implementation of auditing features.

classes.name: ProductType
classes.description: Entity class representing product types, including fields for ID, code, add-to-cart permission, and audit info, with associated JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the product type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of the product type.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit info associated with this product type.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit info for this product type.

methods.name: isAllowAddToCart
methods.description: Checks whether adding the product type to cart is allowed.

methods.name: setAllowAddToCart
methods.description: Sets whether the product type allows adding to cart.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code associated with this product type.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for this product type.
